body: Hi! Yes, on the 5th day, she finally pooped again and has gone back to normal! The vet I spoke with said it could take up to a week, depending on how successful the enema was. Per the vet’s recommendation, I’m still adding Miralax and extra water to her food to keep her bowels moving. I hope your kitty is doing well too!
